title: PATH Water & Exceptional Minds: A Partnership for Sustainability & Inclusion
text:
PATH ‘s impactful collaboration with Exceptional Minds is changing the game for corporate social duty.Discover how this partnership integrates sustainability and neurodiversity to create a unique, limited-edition bottle while providing valuable career opportunities. Learn about the meaningful impact these two organizations are making through their combined efforts, proving that purpose-driven businesses can thrive.
PATH Partners with Extraordinary Minds: A Sustainable and Inclusive Collaboration Fremont,Calif. – A new partnership between PATH and Exceptional Minds is set to redefine how businesses can integrate sustainability with social responsibility, offering a blueprint for future collaborations.
EM x PATH Limited Edition Bottle
The Partnership: A Fusion of Sustainability and neurodiversity PATH, known for its commitment to eliminating single-use plastic bottled water through reusable aluminum solutions, has joined forces with exceptional Minds, a nonprofit dedicated to providing young adults on the autism spectrum with careers in digital arts. This collaboration aims to amplify both sustainability efforts and neurodiverse talent.
Exceptional Minds’ artists contributed to exclusive PATH bottle designs and marketing materials, gaining invaluable real-world experience.This initiative not only promotes reusable aluminum bottles but also creates meaningful career opportunities within the creative industry.
Key Takeaways Exclusive Bottle Design: A limited-edition PATH bottle designed by Exceptional Minds student Benny Lloyd is now available. Availability: The bottle can be purchased on PATH’s website, at RiteAid stores nationwide, and in select retailers. Philanthropic Component: A percentage of the proceeds from the bottle sales will be donated to Exceptional Minds, further supporting their mission. Leadership Perspectives Ali Orabi, CMO of PATH, emphasized the dual impact of the partnership:
We are incredibly proud to partner with Exceptional Minds and showcase the amazing talents of these artists. This collaboration is more than just creating eye-catching designs – it’s about driving real impact by empowering neurodiverse talent and advancing sustainability. Together,we’re proving that purpose-driven businesses can uplift communities while protecting the planet. This partnership is a bold step toward a future where inclusivity and sustainability go hand in hand, inspiring change for future generations.
Ali Orabi,CMO of PATH
Andrew Ainsworth,Director of Academic Programs at Exceptional Minds,highlighted the importance of such opportunities for their artists:
Providing opportunities for our talented artists is what Exceptional Minds is all about. Enlightened companies like PATH recognize that inclusion and diversity make for better products and a better world. I am delighted that Benny has the experience of seeing their work produced at this scale.
Andrew Ainsworth, Director of Academic Programs at Exceptional Minds
The Broader Impact This partnership represents a significant stride in bridging the gap between environmental sustainability and social impact. By providing tangible career opportunities for neurodiverse individuals, PATH and Exceptional Minds are setting a new standard for corporate social responsibility.
The collaboration serves as an example of how businesses can integrate purpose into their core operations, creating positive change for both the habitat and society.
About PATH PATH is dedicated to eliminating single-use plastic bottled water by offering reusable, 100% recyclable aluminum bottled water solutions. The company combines sustainability with innovation to reduce plastic waste while providing high-quality, purified water.
About Exceptional Minds Exceptional Minds is a nonprofit academy and professional studio that empowers young adults on the autism spectrum with training and career opportunities in digital arts, visual effects, animation, and related fields. Through hands-on experience and industry partnerships, Exceptional Minds prepares individuals for meaningful employment in creative industries.
For more details, visit www.drinkpath.com and www.exceptional-minds.org .
